tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic faces a lawsuit over allegedly using Elvis Presley songs to train Claude. The Star reported this claim.
DeepSeek has open sourced the architecture behind its super agent coding prototype for research purposes. Startup Fortune reported the release.
Orca unifies multiple artificial intelligence coding agents into one open source workspace application. XDA reported on this tool.
Anthropic's IPO prospectus warns of artificial intelligence risks, with 93 pages of dangers and 11.6B in sales. B2B News reported these warnings.
OpenAI now allows ChatGPT Pro users to text their Dot agent for tasks and updates in the US. Yahoo Tech reported this feature.
Free every hour.
